sections.advice: This High point near Chazelles-sur-Lyon → Pollionnay stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch in Chaleins → Photo stop near Châtillon-sur-Chalaronne is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.to: Near La Tour-du-Pin, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Châtillon-sur-Chalaronne → Near La Tour-du-Pin, on the way back can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

sections.from: Near La Tour-du-Pin, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near La Côte-Saint-André → Back to Alpe is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.
